v1.0.9.title: GNSS Improvements & Update Notification
notes: GNSS trajectory: Live track display no longer gets interrupted
Fixed point badges without reference trajectory: Points are now detected via GPS bearing and direct distance
Cancel button when creating a new run
Update notification now shows current and new version number
Release notes viewable directly in the update notification
General improvements and bug fixes

v1.0.8.title: Additional Tools
notes: New Tools section in Settings for additional utilities
MX9 Sensor Calibration: Lever arm calculation for DMI and GAMS from 5 total station measurements
CSV/TXT import of measurement points with automatic format detection
GAMS phase center offset configurable (default: Trimble GA830)
Interactive coordinate visualization with top view and side view
Image galleries with zoom for explaining measurement points and axes

v1.0.7.title: Field Work Improvements
notes: GNSS-Only mode: Complete runs with GPS only, no fixed points required
Fullscreen map in GNSS recording: Map fills the screen with floating controls
GPS follow mode: Map automatically follows current position, manual pan disables follow
Trajectory extension: Reference trajectory extended 500m beyond fixed points (was 50m)
GPS track trimming: Backward sections at start/end are automatically removed
Jobs tab: New main navigation — access jobs directly without going through projects
Quick project: Create jobs without a project, project is auto-created
Interactive point badges: Nearby fixed points appear as tappable badges on the map
Side targets: Separate target board configuration for left and right
GPS-based point prediction: Fixed points suggested based on GPS position along trajectory

v1.0.6.title: CSV Import & Employee Management
notes: CSV import for employees: Semicolon and comma delimiters, automatic header detection
Extended employee data: Company and location as optional fields
CSV import updates existing employees: Company/location are merged instead of skipped
Filter in employee list: Filter by company and/or location
Company shown in measurement job employee list and badges
Inline editing of company and location directly in the employee list
Error handling: App shows error message instead of white screen on crashes
Bugfix: Editing employee name in measurement job no longer clears company/location

v1.0.5.title: GNSS Filter & Backup Improvements
notes: GNSS track filter with Savitzky-Golay smoothing for accurate distance calculation
Motion detection: Standstill noise is automatically filtered out
Direction-based distance: Only forward movement is counted
Init phase with progress indicator until travel direction is established
GPS distance along reference trajectory: Spline distance instead of GPS accumulation
GPS position on map now shown in yellow (better distinction from fixed points)
GPS zoom: Closer zoom when clicking the GPS button
Complete backup: Reference trajectories and company logos are now included
More robust backup import: Missing data fields no longer cause crashes

v1.0.4.title: Spline Trajectory & Map Support
notes: Automatic trajectory from fixed point field (Catmull-Rom spline)
Station-based centerline through point pair detection (L/R)
Start point snapping to trajectory instead of arbitrary map clicks
GPS position snapped to trajectory during recording
Configurable station tolerance (5-100m) via slider
Smoothing slider for smoother curves (0-5 in 0.2 increments)
Track side filter: All/Left/Right for parallel tracks
Direction reversal button with automatic left/right adjustment
Trajectory extended 50m beyond fixed points

v1.0.3.title: Layout & Export Improvements
notes: General layout changes for better overview
PDF export layout revised for better readability
Company logo insertion now possible

v1.0.2.title: Measurement Job Structure & Export Improvements
notes: New measurement job level: Projects now contain measurement jobs that bundle runs
Scanner settings, weather, employees and fixed point field are configured in the job
Export on two levels: Project export (all jobs) and job export (single job)
Improved PDF protocol: Structured layout, continuation header on page breaks
Employee management: Edit and delete employees in settings and job form
Automatic sorting of measurement runs by recording order in export
Simplified project creation: Only project number, client, construction project and start date

v1.0.1.title: Initial Release
notes: Project Management: Create, edit and delete projects with all relevant information
Measurement Runs: Complete workflow from setup through recording to completion
Fixed Point Management: Import CSV/TXT files and manage multiple fixed point fields
Target Board Selection: Size, height and thickness individually configurable
Active Run Tracking: Global status of running measurement with quick access
Export Functions: PDF, Excel and JSON export for projects and data
Offline Functionality: All data stored locally (IndexedDB)
PWA Support: Installable on home screen (iOS & Android)
Multilingual: German and English
Dark Mode: OLED-optimized for maximum battery savings
